scanner_c.notes: Fresh Oct 4 scan. Sunday news flow was sparse; only two distinct themes met the quality/freshness bar, so the list was not padded. No silent reuse of Oct 3 selections.

items.event_title: Revolut reaches $115 billion valuation as it challenges Europe's incumbent banks
items.news_summary: Reuters profiled Revolut after its valuation reached about $115 billion, making it Europe's most valuable startup and a rapidly scaling challenger to established banks, while highlighting that revenue per customer and lending remain well below incumbent-bank levels.
items.investor_materiality: High for European banks, fintech valuations and any future Revolut listing because the valuation tests how much investors will pay for high-growth digital banking versus mature bank economics.
items.selection_reason: Fresh same-day Reuters business story with a very large private-market valuation and direct read-through to fintech and European banking competition.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-04: Revolut's rise to become Europe's $115 billion big bank rival
items.source_quality_note: Same-day Reuters reporting; high quality. Revolut is private, so there is no public ticker.

items.video_angle: 一家没有上市的金融科技公司值 1150 亿美元：Revolut 凭什么逼近欧洲大银行？

items.event_title: South Korean president orders financial-industry data-leak probe
items.news_summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung ordered a comprehensive investigation and response measures after multiple personal-data leak incidents across banks, financial companies and public agencies.
items.investor_materiality: Medium. The probe raises cybersecurity, compliance and remediation risk for Korean financial institutions and technology vendors, and could lead to tighter data-protection requirements.
items.selection_reason: Fresh same-day official-policy catalyst affecting a major Asian financial market; included because it has clear regulatory and cybersecurity implications even though direct U.S.-equity linkage is weaker than the usual Scanner C technology themes.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-04: South Korean president orders probe into data leaks across financial industry
items.source_quality_note: Same-day Reuters reporting on a presidential-office directive; high quality. Initial reporting did not disclose the full scope of affected institutions.

items.video_angle: 韩国为什么突然全面查金融数据泄露？这可能把银行网络安全成本推到新阶段。
